title: School Van Tracking: Ordering Guarantees Under Unreliable Networks (TLA+ artifacts and preprint)
description:
Formal verification artifacts and preprint for a school-van GPS telemetry protocol. Two-channel TLA+ model (lossy uplink, unordered downlink with redelivery), a guard ablation (no guard, server-only, parent-only, both), unedited TLC logs, a PlusCal sketch, and the TechRxiv preprint source. TLC finds a seven-state MonotonicDisplay violation in the baseline; the parent display guard alone is sufficient for monotonicity in this model, while a server-only guard is not.

Code and specifications: MIT. Paper and documentation: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-docs).
